chapter_seo_title: The Fiendgod Reveals His True Form – Xiangliu Fang Battles a Dao-Soldier Army
chapter_meta_description: The group is trapped by endless Dao-soldiers. Shaoyan Nong’s servant reveals his true form as a nine-headed, thousand-zhang Xiāngliú Fiendgod, but even he may be overwhelmed when the Yaksha Dao-soldiers appear.
og_title: Desolate Era – Chapter 0258: The Fiendgod’s Wrath
og_description: Shaoyan Nong’s servant reveals a nine-headed serpent-tailed Fiendgod body! But the Wu Jiang estate’s Yaksha Dao-soldiers are even more terrifying. Can the team escape?
twitter_title: Desolate Era ch. 0258 – The Fiendgod Revealed
twitter_description: A thousand-zhang, nine-headed Fiendgod takes on a tide of Dao-soldiers. This is primal Xianxia at its finest.

lore_anchors.definition: A primordial, ancient being born from chaos. True Fiendgods (like the Xiangliu clan) possess innate, monstrous bodies and abilities that far exceed those of human cultivators who practice Fiendgod Body Refining.

An ancient Fiendgod clan of nine-headed, serpent-tailed beings from Chinese mythology, associated with floods and venom. In the novel, they are a powerful Fiendgod lineage, with Primal-level members matching Loose Immortals.
A soldier wearing runic Dao-soldier armor that allows a group to merge their power, souls, and attacks into a single, coordinated force. A standard-issue military unit in the Grand Xia Dynasty.
A more elite variant of the standard Dao-soldier, able to form a giant, unified specter. Their appearance raises the threat level even for a Primal-level Fiendgod.

A high-grade defensive treasure that creates an impenetrable barrier even against multiple Loose Immortals. Once activated, passengers cannot leave and attackers cannot enter until the divine light is exhausted.
The fourth major realm of Ki Refining, where the cultivator’s inner Violet Palace develops stars, a moon, and a sun, drastically increasing energy absorption and resonance with the universe.
The five golden pillars at the edges of the immortal estate world, marking the locations of the five sub-palaces that stabilize the entire realm.
